title: Multiform PVCs
what: PVCs of more than one shape (MIT-BIH 233)

title: Bundle branch block + PVCs
what: every beat wide; only some are PVCs (MIT-BIH 214)

title: Atrial fibrillation + PVCs
what: an irregular rhythm, so timing alone misleads (MIT-BIH 221)

title: Bundle branch block, no PVCs
what: wide beats that must not be called (MIT-BIH 212)
